Guests

What people say after

We sat at the counter and watched every course come together. Three hours felt like forty minutes. The lamb is still the best thing I ate all year.

Helena Marques Dined in March · via Google

Booked it for an anniversary and they remembered without being asked. Quiet, dark, genuinely romantic, and the wine pairing was worth every cent.

Tomás Ferreira Dined in February · via TripAdvisor

I have sat through a lot of tasting menus that are mostly theatre. This one is mostly cooking. Nothing on the plate was there for the photograph.

Claire Dubois Dined in April · via Google

Vegetarian menu with no sense of being an afterthought. The cauliflower course was the one everyone at the table talked about on the way home.

Priya Raghavan Dined in January · via OpenTable

Our story

A small room that never grew

We opened in 2014 with eleven tables and a borrowed charcoal grill. Eleven years later there are still eleven tables.

Write the menu after the market, not before it.
